name: client-deep-lpr
description: Clean LPR client. OpenCV via vcpkg. VLC is NOT in vcpkg (install the VideoLAN SDK separately). GStreamer/Pylon/OpenVINO/NATS are installed separately and detected by CMake.

openvino.description: OpenVINO inference backend pulled via vcpkg (CPU + IR frontend). Builds from source -> slow on the first configure. Enable with -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=openvino -DWITH_OPENVINO=ON (or use the full-vcpkg-all preset). If you already have the OpenVINO runtime installed, prefer the full-vcpkg-ov preset instead (no source build).

gstreamer.description: Build the GStreamer RTSP backend (heavy; or install GStreamer system dev packages instead)

nats.description: NATS messaging transport (cnats C client). Enable with -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=nats -DWITH_NATS=ON
